reason: A DSH web plugin that adds a live git branch and clean/dirty indicator to the chat composer, with local branch browsing and branch switching, including optional stashing of changes.

summaries.zh: 在聊天界面的编辑器工具栏中显示当前 Git 分支和工作区状态，并支持浏览及切换本地分支。
summaries.en: Adds a live Git branch and working-tree status indicator to the chat composer, with browsing and switching of local branches.

capabilities: Reads git branch and working-tree status
Lists local git branches and upstream tracking information
Can stash uncommitted and untracked changes before switching
Provides HTTP endpoints for git status and checkout operations
